actionResultText:
Here are your **6 Algebra Formula Flash Cards**! 🎉

Here's how to use them:

1. **Read the front** — a formula name will be shown (e.g., *"Difference of Squares"*).
2. **Recall the formula** — try to write or say it from memory before flipping.
3. **Flip the card** — check the back to see if you got it right.
4. **Repeat** — cycle through all 6 cards until you can recall each one confidently.

The cards cover these 6 essential formulas:

| # | Formula Name |
|---|---|
| 1 | Quadratic Formula |
| 2 | Difference of Squares |
| 3 | Perfect Square Trinomial (Addition) |
| 4 | Perfect Square Trinomial (Subtraction) |
| 5 | Sum of Cubes |
| 6 | Difference of Cubes |

> 💡 **Tip:** Focus on the *pattern* of each formula — once you see the structure, they become much easier to remember! Let me know if you'd like a deeper explanation of any of them.
